64: function checkAssets() {
65:   const sheets = [...document.styleSheets];
66:   const failedStylesheets = sheets.filter((sheet) => !sheet.href && sheet.ownerNode?.tagName === 'LINK')
67:     .map((sheet) => sheet.ownerNode?.getAttribute('href'));
68:   state.checks.assets = {
69:     checkedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
70:     stylesheetCount: sheets.length,
71:     failedStylesheets,
72:     scriptCount: document.scripts.length,
73:   };
74:   failedStylesheets.forEach((href) => pushIssue('error', {
75:     type: 'stylesheet-load', message: `스타일시트 로드 실패: ${href || '알 수 없음'}`,
76:   }));
77:   persist();
78: }

80: function updateBadge() {
81:   const button = document.getElementById('diagnosticsButton');
82:   if (!button) return;
83:   const count = state.errors.length + state.warnings.length;
84:   let badge = button.querySelector('em');
85:   if (count > 0) {
86:     if (!badge) { badge = document.createElement('em'); button.appendChild(badge); }
87:     badge.textContent = String(count);
88:     button.title = `시스템 진단: 오류 ${state.errors.length}, 경고 ${state.warnings.length}`;
89:   } else if (badge) {
90:     badge.remove();
91:   }
92: }

94: function statusLabel() {
95:   if (state.errors.length) return '점검 필요';
96:   if (state.warnings.length) return '주의';
97:   return '정상';
98: }

100: function renderDiagnostics() {
101:   checkDom();
102:   checkAssets();
103:   const old = document.getElementById('uepDiagnosticsModal');
104:   if (old) old.remove();
105: 
106:   const modal = document.createElement('div');
107:   modal.id = 'uepDiagnosticsModal';
108:   modal.className = 'uep-diagnostics-backdrop';
109:   const issues = [...state.errors.map((x) => ({ ...x, level: '오류' })), ...state.warnings.map((x) => ({ ...x, level: '경고' }))];
110:   const issueHtml = issues.length
111:     ? issues.slice(-30).reverse().map((item) => `<tr><td>${safeText(item.level)}</td><td>${safeText(item.type)}</td><td>${safeText(item.message)}</td><td>${safeText(item.source || '')}${item.line ? `:${item.line}` : ''}</td></tr>`).join('')
112:     : '<tr><td colspan="4" class="diag-empty">현재 수집된 오류와 경고가 없습니다.</td></tr>';
113: 
114:   modal.innerHTML = `
115:     <section class="uep-diagnostics-panel" role="dialog" aria-modal="true" aria-label="UEP 시스템 진단">
116:       <header><div><small>UEP v${VERSION}</small><h2>시스템 진단</h2></div><button type="button" id="diagnosticsClose">×</button></header>
117:       <div class="diag-summary">
118:         <article><span>상태</span><b>${statusLabel()}</b></article>

120:         <article><span>경고</span><b>${state.warnings.length}</b></article>
121:         <article><span>중복 DOM ID</span><b>${state.checks.dom?.duplicateIds?.length || 0}</b></article>
122:         <article><span>CSS 파일</span><b>${state.checks.assets?.stylesheetCount || 0}</b></article>
123:       </div>
124:       <p class="diag-note">프로그램 실행 중 발생하는 JavaScript 오류, 처리되지 않은 Promise 오류, 중복 화면 ID와 리소스 로드 상태를 자동 기록합니다.</p>
125:       <div class="diag-table-wrap"><table><thead><tr><th>구분</th><th>유형</th><th>내용</th><th>위치</th></tr></thead><tbody>${issueHtml}</tbody></table></div>
126:       <footer><span>마지막 점검: ${new Date().toLocaleString('ko-KR')}</span><div><button type="button" id="diagnosticsCopy">결과 복사</button><button type="button" id="diagnosticsClear">기록 초기화</button><button type="button" id="diagnosticsRun">다시 점검</button></div></footer>
127:     </section>`;
128:   document.body.appendChild(modal);

133:   modal.querySelector('#diagnosticsRun').addEventListener('click', renderDiagnostics);
134:   modal.querySelector('#diagnosticsClear').addEventListener('click', () => {

190: function uepDiagSafe(value,depth=0){
191:   if(depth>6)return '[DEPTH_LIMIT]';
192:   if(value==null||typeof value==='number'||typeof value==='boolean')return value;
193:   if(typeof value==='string')return value.replace(/[A-Z0-9._%+-]+@[A-Z0-9.-]+\.[A-Z]{2,}/gi,'[EMAIL_REDACTED]').slice(0,4000);
194:   if(Array.isArray(value))return value.slice(0,30).map(v=>uepDiagSafe(v,depth+1));
195:   if(typeof value==='object'){
196:     const out={};
197:     for(const [k,v] of Object.entries(value)){
198:       if(/token|secret|password|authorization|cookie|credential|private|email|name/i.test(k)){out[k]='[REDACTED]';continue;}
199:       out[k]=uepDiagSafe(v,depth+1);
200:     }
201:     return out;
202:   }
203:   return String(value);
204: }
205: function uepDiagRecord(stage,value){
206:   uepSchoolReadDiagnostics.push({at:new Date().toISOString(),stage,value:uepDiagSafe(value)});
207:   if(uepSchoolReadDiagnostics.length>80)uepSchoolReadDiagnostics.shift();
208: }

339: function normalizeSavedState() {
340:   const validPages = new Set(["dashboard","students","dorm","timetable","attendance","scores","admissions","records","programs","alerts","calendar","work","duties","forms","outputs","settings","help"]);
341:   if (!validPages.has(state.activePage)) state.activePage = "dashboard";
342:   if (!["mine","homeroom","student","teacher"].includes(state.timetableTab)) state.timetableTab = "mine";
343:   if (!["month","week"].includes(state.calendarMode)) state.calendarMode = "month";
344: 
345:   state.tasks = Array.isArray(state.tasks) ? state.tasks.filter(Boolean).map(task=>({status:task.done?"done":(task.status||"planned"),...task})) : structuredClone(baseState.tasks);
346:   ensureDevelopmentTasks();
347:   state.programEvidence = state.programEvidence && typeof state.programEvidence === "object" ? state.programEvidence : {};
348:   state.issueReports = Array.isArray(state.issueReports) ? state.issueReports.filter(Boolean) : [];
349:   state.programAdminReports = state.programAdminReports && typeof state.programAdminReports === "object" ? state.programAdminReports : {};
350:   state.programOverrides = state.programOverrides && typeof state.programOverrides === "object" ? state.programOverrides : {};
351:   state.autoAlertAcks = state.autoAlertAcks && typeof state.autoAlertAcks === "object" ? state.autoAlertAcks : {};
352:   state.programs = (Array.isArray(state.programs) ? state.programs : structuredClone(baseState.programs))
353:     .filter((program) => program && typeof program === "object")
354:     .map((program) => ({
355:       ...program,
356:       students: (Array.isArray(program.students) ? program.students : []).map((student) => {
357:         if (student && typeof student === "object")
358:           return { number: String(student.number || ""), name: String(student.name || "") };
359:         const [number = "", ...name] = String(student || "").trim().split(/\s+/);
360:         return { number, name: name.join(" ") };
361:       }),
362:     }));
363: 
364:   state.gradeNotices = (Array.isArray(state.gradeNotices) ? state.gradeNotices : structuredClone(baseState.gradeNotices))
365:     .filter((item) => item && typeof item === "object" && String(item.title || "").trim() !== "방학식 학생 안내 확인")
366:     .map((item) => ({
367:       ...item,
368:       requiredClasses: Array.isArray(item.requiredClasses) ? item.requiredClasses : [],
369:       confirmedClasses: Array.isArray(item.confirmedClasses) ? item.confirmedClasses : [],
370:     }));
371:   state.reportDeadlines = (Array.isArray(state.reportDeadlines) ? state.reportDeadlines : structuredClone(baseState.reportDeadlines)).filter(Boolean);
372:   state.schoolDeadlines = (Array.isArray(state.schoolDeadlines) ? state.schoolDeadlines : structuredClone(baseState.schoolDeadlines)).filter(Boolean);
373:   state.dormOutings = (Array.isArray(state.dormOutings) ? state.dormOutings : structuredClone(baseState.dormOutings))
374:     .filter((item) => item && typeof item === "object")
375:     .map((item) => ({ date: dateKey(today), ...item }));
376:

840: function checkPeriodAlerts() {
841:   const setting = state.settings.widgetSettings.timetable || {};
842:   if (!setting.startAlert && !setting.endAlert) return;
843:   const now = new Date();
844:   const hhmm = `${String(now.getHours()).padStart(2, "0")}:${String(now.getMinutes()).padStart(2, "0")}`;
845:   const key = `${dateKey(now)}-${hhmm}`;
846:   if (key === lastPeriodAlertKey) return;
847:   for (const row of (state.settings.schoolHours || [])) {
848:     const name = row[0], start = row[1], end = row[2];
849:     let message = "";
850:     if (setting.startAlert && start === hhmm && String(name).includes("교시")) message = `${name} 수업이 시작됩니다.`;
851:     if (setting.endAlert && end === hhmm && String(name).includes("교시")) message = `${name} 수업이 종료됩니다.`;
852:     if (message) {
853:       lastPeriodAlertKey = key;
854:       toast(message);
855:       try { if ("Notification" in window && Notification.permission === "granted") new Notification("UEP 시간표 알림", { body: message }); } catch {}
856:       break;
857:     }
858:   }
859: }

965:     const desc=mode==='unlock'?(subject?'과목별 신청현황을 확인하려면 선택과목 대외비 비밀번호를 입력하세요.':'상세정보를 확인하려면 민감정보 비밀번호를 입력하세요.'):'비밀번호 원문은 저장하지 않고 해시값만 기본정보 연결시트의 공용 설정에 보관합니다.';

971:         ${mode==='set'?'<label>새 비밀번호 확인<input type="password" autocomplete="new-password" data-sensitive-second></label>':''}

975:     </div>`;

979:     const submit=()=>{

981:       const first=layer.querySelector('[data-sensitive-first]')?.value||'';
982:       const second=layer.querySelector('[data-sensitive-second]')?.value||'';

987:     };
988:     layer.querySelectorAll('[data-sensitive-modal-close]').forEach(b=>b.onclick=cancel);

990:     layer.querySelector('[data-sensitive-modal-submit]').onclick=submit;
991:     const passwordInputs=[...layer.querySelectorAll('input[type="password"]')];

994:       input.addEventListener('keydown',event=>{if(event.key==='Enter'){event.preventDefault();event.stopImmediatePropagation();submit();return;}event.stopImmediatePropagation();},true);
995:       ['keypress','keyup','beforeinput','input','paste'].forEach(type=>input.addEventListener(type,event=>event.stopImmediatePropagation(),true));
996:     });
997:     setTimeout(()=>layer.querySelector('[data-sensitive-current],[data-sensitive-first]')?.focus(),0);

1661: function calendarEventIsPending(event) {

1665: function calendarEventTargetsFirstGrade(event) {
1666:   const target = String(event?.target || "").replace(/\s+/g, " ").trim();
1667:   const detail = String(event?.detail || "").replace(/\s+/g, " ").replace(/\(?1\s*[,·ㆍ&/]?\s*2?\s*학년부[^)]*\)?/g, " ");
1668:   if (/학부모/.test(target) && !/학생/.test(target)) return false;
1669:   if (/교사|교직원/.test(target) && !/학생/.test(target)) return false;
1670:   const text = target || detail;
1671:   return /(?:^|[^0-9])1\s*학년/.test(text)
1672:     || /1\s*[,·ㆍ&/]\s*2\s*학년/.test(text)
1673:     || /1\s*[~-]\s*3\s*학년/.test(text)
1674:     || /전교생|전체\s*학생/.test(text);
1675: }

1677: function calendarEventLooksLikeProgram(event) {
1678:   const text = `${event?.title || ""} ${event?.target || ""} ${event?.detail || ""}`;
1679:   if (/(정기고사|기말고사|중간고사|방학식|개학식|교직원회의|부장교사회의|운영위원회|석식\s*[Xx]|급식제공|시간표\s*운영|교실개방|생활기록부.*점검|입찰|폐지\(|폐기물|제안서.*제출기간)/.test(text)) return false;
1680:   return /(프로그램|특강|체험|교육|설명회|공연|상담|탐방|캠프|연수|활동|동아리|수련|수학여행|대회|촬영|학습코칭|석학과의 만남)/.test(text);
1681: }

1940: function studentCardHeatPeriodDays(){try{return localStorage.getItem(STUDENT_CARD_HEAT_PERIOD_STORE)==='7'?7:30;}catch{return 30;}}

1942: function readStudentCardHeatStore(){try{const raw=JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(STUDENT_CARD_HEAT_STORE)||'{}');return raw&&typeof raw==='object'&&!Array.isArray(raw)?raw:{};}catch{return {};}}
1943: function writeStudentCardHeatStore(store){try{localStorage.setItem(STUDENT_CARD_HEAT_STORE,JSON.stringify(store||{}));}catch{}}
1944: function studentCardHeat(student){const id=studentCardHeatId(student);if(!id)return 0;const store=readStudentCardHeatStore(),cutoff=Date.now()-studentCardHeatPeriodDays()*86400000;const recent=(Array.isArray(store[id])?store[id]:[]).map(Number).filter(t=>Number.isFinite(t)&&t>=cutoff);return recent.length;}
1945: function touchStudentCardHeat(student){const id=studentCardHeatId(student);if(!id)return 0;const store=readStudentCardHeatStore(),history=(Array.isArray(store[id])?store[id]:[]).map(Number).filter(Number.isFinite);history.push(Date.now());store[id]=history.filter(t=>t>=Date.now()-31*86400000).slice(-80);writeStudentCardHeatStore(store);return studentCardHeat(student);}

2006: function nightStudyOperationStatus(key){
2007:   const date=new Date(`${key}T12:00:00`);
2008:   const rules=readNightStudyRules().filter(r=>r&&r.active!==false);
2009:   for(const r of rules){
2010:     if(r.type==='range'&&r.start&&r.end&&key>=r.start&&key<=r.end)return {operates:false,reason:r.name||'미운영 기간'};
2011:     if(r.type==='weekday'&&Number(r.weekday)===date.getDay())return {operates:false,reason:r.name||'요일 미운영'};
2012:   }
2013:   return {operates:true,reason:'운영일'};
2014: }

2056: function dormRuleNormalizeDateTime(value){
2057:   if(value===null||value===undefined||value==='') return '';
2058:   // Google Sheets 날짜 직렬값은 시트의 '현지 날짜/시간' 값이다.
2059:   // UTC instant로 해석한 뒤 Asia/Seoul을 다시 적용하면 +9시간이 생기므로,
2060:   // 직렬값의 날짜/시간 성분을 그대로 추출한다.
2061:   if(typeof value==='number'||/^\d+(?:\.\d+)?$/.test(String(value).trim())){
2062:     const serial=Number(value);
2063:     if(Number.isFinite(serial)&&serial>20000&&serial<100000){
2064:       const d=new Date(Date.UTC(1899,11,30)+Math.round(serial*86400000));
2065:       if(!Number.isNaN(d.getTime())){
2066:         const y=d.getUTCFullYear(),m=String(d.getUTCMonth()+1).padStart(2,'0'),day=String(d.getUTCDate()).padStart(2,'0');
2067:         const hh=String(d.getUTCHours()).padStart(2,'0'),mm=String(d.getUTCMinutes()).padStart(2,'0');
2068:         return `${y}-${m}-${day}T${hh}:${mm}`;
2069:       }
2070:     }
2071:   }
2072:   const raw=String(value).trim().replace(' ','T');
2073:   const m=raw.match(/^(\d{4})-(\d{1,2})-(\d{1,2})T(\d{1,2}):(\d{2})/);
2074:   if(m) return `${m[1]}-${String(m[2]).padStart(2,'0')}-${String(m[3]).padStart(2,'0')}T${String(m[4]).padStart(2,'0')}:${m[5]}`;
2075:   return String(value).trim();
2076: }

2086: }

3171: function inputCenterClassifyMaterial(file={}, textValue=''){

3173:   const text=String(textValue||file?.text||'');

3175:   const rules=[
3176:     {type:'프로그램 신청서',score:[/신청자|참가신청|신청 활동|신청 프로그램|희망 진로|희망순위|신청서/g,/연락처|학년|반|번호|이름/g],reason:'신청·희망·참가 관련 열/문구'},

3183:   ];

3464: function inputCenterHumanReportText(value=''){
3465:   const source=String(value||'').trim();if(!source)return '';
3466:   try{
3467:     const meta=JSON.parse(source);
3468:     const fields=Array.isArray(meta?.fields)?meta.fields:Array.isArray(meta)?meta:[];
3469:     const skip=/^(연락처|전화번호|휴대폰|서명|이메일|학번|성명|이름|학년|반|수정시간|제출시간|제출일시)$/;
3470:     const pairs=fields.map((f,i)=>({label:String(f?.label||`문항 ${i+1}`).trim(),value:String(f?.value||'').trim()})).filter(x=>x.value&&!skip.test(x.label));
3471:     if(pairs.length)return pairs.map(x=>`[${x.label||'문항'}]\n${x.value}`).join('\n\n');
3472:   }catch{}
3473:   return source;
3474: }

4547: function accessAccountRole(account){

6937: function programDurationHours(program){
6938:   const direct=Number(program?.hours||program?.durationHours||program?.totalHours);
6939:   if(Number.isFinite(direct)&&direct>0)return direct;
6940:   const sessionCount=Number(program?.sessionCount||program?.sessions||String(program?.sessionNo||"").match(/\d+/)?.[0]);
6941:   if(Number.isFinite(sessionCount)&&sessionCount>0)return sessionCount;
6942:   const time=String(program?.time||"");
6943:   const match=time.match(/(\d{1,2}):(\d{2})\s*[~〜-]\s*(\d{1,2}):(\d{2})/);
6944:   if(match){const start=Number(match[1])*60+Number(match[2]);const end=Number(match[3])*60+Number(match[4]);if(end>start)return Math.round((end-start)/6)/10;}
6945:   return program?.date?1:0;
6946: }

7297:   const timeLabel=timeMatch?(()=>{const h=Number(timeMatch[1]),m=timeMatch[2];return `${h<12?'오전':'오후'} ${h%12||12}:${m}`;})():'';
7298:   if(days==null)return [prefix,timeLabel].filter(Boolean).join(' · ');

7303:   return `${prefix} · ${md}${timeLabel?` ${timeLabel}`:''}`;

7723: function normalizeTeacherTimetableCell(cell){
7724:   if(!cell)return null;
7725:   if(typeof cell==="string")return {subject:cell,room:"",changed:false};
7726:   if(Array.isArray(cell)){
7727:     const subject=String(cell[1]||cell[0]||"").trim();
7728:     const room=String(cell[3]||cell[2]||"").trim();
7729:     return subject?{subject,room,changed:false}:null;
7730:   }
7731:   const subject=String(cell.subject||cell.subjectName||cell.name||cell.course||cell.className||"").trim();
7732:   const room=String(cell.location||cell.room||cell.classroom||cell.gradeClass||cell.classNo||"").trim();
7733:   return subject?{subject,room,changed:Boolean(cell.isChanged||cell.changed||cell.changeInfo),changeInfo:cell.changeInfo||""}:null;
7734: }
7735: function personalTimetableData() {
7736:   const teacher=String(currentLoginTeacherName()||state.settings.comciganTeacher||state.settings.teacherName||"담당교사").trim();
7737:   // 홍석민 교사는 사용자가 제공한 2026학년도 공식 교사시간표 PDF를
7738:   // 최우선 기준으로 사용해 잘못 매칭된 컴시간 자료가 표시되지 않게 합니다.
7739:   const masterReference=masterTeacherTimetableData(teacher);
7740:   if(masterReference)return masterReference;
7741:   // 연결 전 고정/샘플 교사시간표는 오인 가능성이 있어 배포판에서 사용하지 않는다.
7742:   const timetable=neisData?.timetable||{};
7743:   const teacherMap=timetable.teachers||{};
7744:   const all=timetable.teacherTimetable||{};
7745:   let teacherKey="";
7746:   for(const [key,value] of Object.entries(teacherMap||{})){
7747:     const name=typeof value==="string"?value:(value?.name||value?.teacherName||value?.label||"");
7748:     if(String(name).trim()===teacher){teacherKey=key;break;}
7749:   }
7750:   let source=all?.[teacherKey]||all?.[teacher]||null;
7751:   if(!source&&Array.isArray(all)) source=all.find(row=>String(row?.teacher||row?.teacherName||row?.name||"").trim()===teacher);
7752:   const week=Array.from({length:7},()=>Array(5).fill(""));
7753:   let found=0,changed=0;
7754:   const setCell=(period,day,cell)=>{
7755:     const p=Number(period),d=Number(day);const normalized=normalizeTeacherTimetableCell(cell);
7756:     if(!normalized||p<1||p>7||d<0||d>4)return;
7757:     week[p-1][d]=`${normalized.subject}|${normalized.room}${normalized.changed?"|changed":""}`;found+=1;if(normalized.changed)changed+=1;
7758:   };
7759:   if(Array.isArray(source)){
7760:     if(source.length>=5&&source.slice(0,5).every(day=>Array.isArray(day))){
7761:       source.slice(0,5).forEach((day,d)=>day.forEach((cell,index)=>setCell(cell?.classTime||cell?.period||cell?.classTimeNum||index+1,d,cell)));
7762:     }else{
7763:       source.forEach((cell,index)=>{
7764:         const d=Number(cell?.dayIndex??cell?.weekdayIndex??cell?.day??cell?.weekDay??-1);
7765:         const day=d>=1&&d<=5?d-1:d;
7766:         setCell(cell?.classTime||cell?.period||cell?.classTimeNum||Math.floor(index/5)+1,day,cell);
7767:       });
7768:     }
7769:   }else if(source&&typeof source==="object"){
7770:     const dayKeys=[["월","monday","mon","1"],["화","tuesday","tue","2"],["수","wednesday","wed","3"],["목","thursday","thu","4"],["금","friday","fri","5"]];
7771:     dayKeys.forEach((keys,d)=>{const day=keys.map(k=>source[k]).find(Boolean);if(Array.isArray(day))day.forEach((cell,index)=>setCell(cell?.classTime||cell?.period||index+1,d,cell));});
7772:   }
7773:   if(found)return {week,days:["월","화","수","목","금"],teacher,source:neisData?.offline?"컴시간 저장자료":"컴시간 실시간",reference:false,changed};
7774:   return {week:[],days:["월","화","수","목","금"],teacher,source:"연결 대기",reference:false,changed:0};
7775: }

7895: function schoolPeriodStatus(now) {
7896:   const minute = now.getHours() * 60 + now.getMinutes();
7897:   const periods = [[520,570],[580,630],[640,690],[700,750],[820,870],[880,930],[940,990]];
7898:   const index = periods.findIndex(([start, end]) => minute >= start && minute <= end);
7899:   if (index >= 0) return { index, label: `현재 ${index + 1}교시` };
7900:   if (minute < periods[0][0]) return { index: -1, label: "일과 시작 전" };
7901:   if (minute > periods[6][1]) return { index: -1, label: "정규수업 종료" };
7902:   if (minute >= 750 && minute < 820) return { index: -1, label: "점심시간" };
7903:   return { index: -1, label: "쉬는 시간" };
7904: }

8282: function dashboardAfterProgramsForDay(dayKey){
8283:   // 일정 표시는 강좌 마스터가 아니라 실제 차시만 사용한다.
8284:   // afterSchoolProgramGroups()가 12_차시일정/실제 일정과 과거 출결 fallback을 단일화한다.
8285:   const canonical=typeof afterSchoolProgramGroups==="function"?afterSchoolProgramGroups():[];
8286:   const seen=new Set();
8287:   return canonical.filter(program=>{
8288:     if(!program||program.kind!=="after"||program.isCourseMaster) return false;
8289:     const pday=String(program.date||program.sessionDate||program.operationDate||"").slice(0,10);
8290:     if(pday!==dayKey||!programHasNightStudyImpact(program)||/취소|휴강|결강|폐강|미운영/.test(String(program.status||program.operationState||program.sessionStatus||""))) return false;
8291:     const session=String(program.sessionId||"").trim();
8292:     const course=String(program.courseId||program.programId||program.id||"").replace(/^after-(?:course|master|session)-/,"").trim();
8293:     const slot=typeof dashboardProgramNightSlot==="function"?dashboardProgramNightSlot(program):String(program.time||"");
8294:     const title=String(program.actualTitle||program.title||program.type||"").replace(/\s/g,"").trim();
8295:     const key=session?`session|${session}`:[course,pday,slot,title].join("|");
8296:     if(seen.has(key)) return false;
8297:     seen.add(key);
8298:     return true;
8299:   });
8300: }

8896:   return '';

9147: function counselPriorityCandidateForStudent(student){
9148:   const base=admissionBase(student.id),mock=latestMockSnapshot(student.id),prep=studentPreparationStats(student);
9149:   const actual9=base.actual9;
9150:   const reasons=[],tags=[];
9151:   let score=0;
9152:   if(actual9!=null){
9153:     const seoulRule=uepManagementRule('inseoul'),regionalRule=uepManagementRule('regional');
9154:     const d25=Math.abs(actual9-seoulRule.internal),d40=Math.abs(actual9-regionalRule.internal);
9155:     if(d25<=seoulRule.boundary){score+=120-Math.round(d25*100);reasons.push(`9등급 평균 ${actual9.toFixed(2)} · ${seoulRule.internal.toFixed(1)} 경계`);tags.push('2.5 경계');}
9156:     if(d40<=regionalRule.boundary){score+=105-Math.round(d40*100);reasons.push(`9등급 평균 ${actual9.toFixed(2)} · ${regionalRule.internal.toFixed(1)} 경계`);tags.push('4.0 경계');}
9157:   }
9158:   const managementGroup=actual9!=null?uepBaseManagementGroup(actual9,base.avg5):'general';
9159:   const inseoulInternal=managementGroup==='inseoul';
9160:   const inseoulMock=uepMockCoreFor('inseoul',mock);
9161:   const regionalInternal=managementGroup==='inseoul'||managementGroup==='regional';
9162:   const regionalMock=uepMockCoreFor('regional',mock);
9163:   const imbalance=[];
9164:   if(inseoulInternal&&!inseoulMock){score+=90;imbalance.push('인서울 내신 우세·모의 보완');}
9165:   else if(!inseoulInternal&&inseoulMock){score+=92;imbalance.push('인서울 모의 우세·내신 보완');}
9166:   if(regionalInternal&&!regionalMock){score+=72;imbalance.push('지거국 내신 우세·모의 보완');}
9167:   else if(!regionalInternal&&regionalMock){score+=74;imbalance.push('지거국 모의 우세·내신 보완');}
9168:   if(imbalance.length){reasons.push(...imbalance);tags.push('내신↔모의 불균형');}
9169:   const participation=Number(prep.selected||0)+Number(prep.after||0)+Number(prep.night||0)+Number(prep.reports||0);
9170:   if(participation===0){score+=58;reasons.push('프로그램·심화학습 참여 이력 부족');tags.push('참여 부족');}
9171:   else if(Number(prep.selected||0)===0){score+=38;reasons.push('계열 연계 선택활동 참여 부족');tags.push('선택활동 부족');}
9172:   if(!reasons.length)return null;
9173:   let group='growth',stage='interest';
9174:   if(imbalance.some(x=>x.startsWith('인서울'))||tags.includes('2.5 경계')){group='inseoul';stage='growth';}
9175:   else if(imbalance.some(x=>x.startsWith('지거국'))||tags.includes('4.0 경계')){group='regional';stage='growth';}
9176:   return {student,base,mock,prep,group,stage,score,reasons:[...new Set(reasons)],tags:[...new Set(tags)]};
9177: }

9422: function dashboardTodayProgramVisible(program){

9428:   if(program.showTodayProgram===false||program.showOnDashboard===false||program.dashboardVisible===false||program.dashboardShow===false)return false;

9468: function isWholeSchoolCommonActivity(program){
9469:   if(!program)return false;
9470:   const type=String(program.type||program.category||program.programType||program.activityType||'');
9471:   const target=String(program.target||program.targetText||program.audience||program.participantScope||'');
9472:   const common=type.includes('공통')||type.includes('공통활동');
9473:   const whole=target.includes('전교생')||target.includes('전체')||target.includes('1학년 전체')||target.includes('공통');
9474:   return common&&whole;
9475: }
9476: function isWholeSchoolDashboardCalendarEvent(event){
9477:   if(!event)return false;
9478:   const target=String(event.target||event.targetText||event.audience||'').replace(/\s/g,'');
9479:   const type=String(event.type||event.category||'');
9480:   const title=String(event.title||'');
9481:   const whole=/전교생|전체학생|전학년|학생전체|학교전체/.test(target);
9482:   const schoolWideCeremony=/개학식|방학식|입학식|졸업식/.test(title)&&(!target||whole);
9483:   return whole||(/공통행사/.test(type)&&whole)||schoolWideCeremony;
9484: }

9487: function normalizeTimetableGradeClass(row){
9488:   const directGrade=Number(row?.grade??row?.학년??0);
9489:   const directClass=Number(row?.classNo??row?.class??row?.반??0);
9490:   if(directGrade>=1&&directGrade<=3&&directClass>=1&&directClass<=20)return {grade:directGrade,classNo:directClass};
9491:   const raw=String(row?.classCode??row?.classroom??row?.학급??row?.반코드??row?.['학년반']??'').trim();
9492:   const digits=raw.replace(/\D/g,'');
9493:   if(digits.length===3){
9494:     const grade=Number(digits[0]),classNo=Number(digits.slice(1));
9495:     if(grade>=1&&grade<=3&&classNo>=1&&classNo<=20)return {grade,classNo};
9496:   }
9497:   if(digits.length===4){
9498:     const grade=Number(digits[0]),classNo=Number(digits.slice(1,3));
9499:     if(grade>=1&&grade<=3&&classNo>=1&&classNo<=20)return {grade,classNo};
9500:   }
9501:   return {grade:directGrade||1,classNo:directClass||Number(digits)||0};
9502: }

10230: function shiftTimetableDate(value, amountDays) {
10231:   const base = new Date(`${String(value || dateKey(new Date()))}T12:00:00`);
10232:   if (Number.isNaN(base.getTime())) return dateKey(new Date());
10233:   base.setDate(base.getDate() + Number(amountDays || 0));
10234:   return dateKey(base);
10235: }
10236: function timetableWeekLabel(value) {
10237:   const base = new Date(`${String(value || dateKey(new Date()))}T12:00:00`);
10238:   if (Number.isNaN(base.getTime())) return "주간 선택";
10239:   const day = base.getDay();

10333: function studentAccessContext(student){

12081: function allConnectedReports(){
12082:   const reports=[];
12083:   (readonlyCache?.students||[]).forEach(student=>(student.reports||[]).forEach(report=>reports.push({...report,__student:student})));
12084:   (readonlyCache?.programs||[]).forEach(program=>(program.reportReports||[]).forEach(report=>reports.push({...report,__program:program})));
12085:   const unique=new Map();
12086:   reports.forEach(report=>{if(report?.id&&!unique.has(String(report.id)))unique.set(String(report.id),report);});
12087:   return [...unique.values()];
12088: }
12089: function findConnectedReport(reportId, student){
12090:   const id=String(reportId||"");

12336: function parseStudentLine(line) {
12337:   const trimmed = String(line || "").trim();
12338:   if (!trimmed) return { number: "", name: "" };
12339:   const parts = trimmed.includes("\t")
12340:     ? trimmed.split(/\t+/)
12341:     : trimmed.includes(",")
12342:       ? trimmed.split(/,+/)
12343:       : trimmed.split(/\s+/);
12344:   return { number: (parts.shift() || "").trim(), name: parts.join(" ").trim() };
12345: }

12852: async function loadWeather() {
12853:   try {
12854:     const response = await fetch(
12855:       "https://api.open-meteo.com/v1/forecast?latitude=36.6424&longitude=127.4890&current=temperature_2m,apparent_temperature,relative_humidity_2m,weather_code,precipitation,wind_speed_10m&hourly=temperature_2m,relative_humidity_2m,precipitation_probability,weather_code,wind_speed_10m&daily=weather_code,temperature_2m_max,temperature_2m_min,precipitation_probability_max&timezone=Asia%2FSeoul&forecast_days=8",
12856:     );
12857:     if (!response.ok) throw new Error("weather unavailable");
12858:     const data = await response.json();
12859:     const now = new Date();
12860:     const currentHour = now.getHours();
12861:     const hourKey = `${now.getFullYear()}-${String(now.getMonth() + 1).padStart(2, "0")}-${String(now.getDate()).padStart(2, "0")}T${String(currentHour).padStart(2, "0")}:00`;
12862:     const currentIndex = Math.max(0, data.hourly.time.indexOf(hourKey));
12863:     weatherState = {
12864:       temp: Math.round(data.current.temperature_2m),
12865:       feels: Math.round(data.current.apparent_temperature),
12866:       code: data.current.weather_code,
12867:       humidity: data.current.relative_humidity_2m ?? 0,
12868:       wind: Math.round((data.current.wind_speed_10m ?? 0) * 10) / 10,
12869:       rain: data.hourly.precipitation_probability[currentIndex] ?? 0,
12870:       precipitation: data.current.precipitation ?? 0,
12871:       daily: data.daily.time.map((time, index) => ({
12872:         time,
12873:         code: data.daily.weather_code[index],
12874:         max: Math.round(data.daily.temperature_2m_max[index]),
12875:         min: Math.round(data.daily.temperature_2m_min[index]),
12876:         rain: data.daily.precipitation_probability_max[index] ?? 0,
12877:       })),
12878:       hourly: data.hourly.time.slice(currentIndex, currentIndex + 8).map((time, offset) => {
12900: function weatherLabel(code) {
12901:   if (code === 0) return { icon: "☀️", text: "맑음" };
12902:   if ([1, 2].includes(code)) return { icon: "🌤️", text: "구름 조금" };
12903:   if ([3, 45, 48].includes(code)) return { icon: "☁️", text: "흐림" };
12904:   if ([51, 53, 55, 61, 63, 65, 80, 81, 82].includes(code))
12905:     return { icon: "🌧️", text: "비" };
12906:   if ([71, 73, 75, 77, 85, 86].includes(code))
12907:     return { icon: "🌨️", text: "눈" };
12908:   if ([95, 96, 99].includes(code)) return { icon: "⛈️", text: "뇌우" };
12909:   return { icon: "○", text: "날씨" };
12910: }

15100: function uep08244UniversityDisplayName(university){

15102:   if(!name||!campus||/캠퍼스/i.test(name)||/\bERICA\b|\bWISE\b/i.test(name))return name;

15104:   const base=name.replace(/\s+(미래|세종|글로컬|WISE)(?:캠퍼스)?$/i,'').trim();
15105:   const all=typeof dashboardAdmissionUniversities==='function'?dashboardAdmissionUniversities():[];

15107:   return multi||sibling?name+' '+campus+'캠퍼스':name;

15109: function uep08251CampusRegion(segment,name=''){
15110:   const s=String(segment||'').replace(/캠퍼스$/,'').trim(),n=String(name||'').trim();
15111:   if(!s)return '';
15112:   if(s==='글로벌'&&/한국외국어대학교|가천대학교/.test(n))return '경기';
15113:   if(s==='메디컬'&&/가천대학교/.test(n))return '인천';
15114:   const rules=[['서울',/서울|관악|신촌/],['경기',/경기|수원|안산|고양|죽전|용인|안성|평택|다빈치|국제|의정부|의왕|성남/],['인천',/인천|송도/],['충북',/충북|청주|충주|증평|개신|글로컬/],['충남',/충남|천안|아산|당진|서산|태안|예산|논산|공주/],['대전',/대전/],['세종',/세종/],['강원',/강원|원주|미래/],['부산',/부산/],['대구',/대구/],['광주',/광주/],['전북',/전북|전주/],['전남',/전남|나주|여수/],['경북',/경북|포항|경주|경산|상주|WISE/],['경남',/경남|진주|통영|창원|양산|밀양|울산/]];
15115:   for(const [r,re] of rules)if(re.test(s))return r;
15116:   return '';
15117: }
15118: function uep08223UniversityRegions(university){
15119:   const name=String(university?.['대학명']||'').trim(),campus=String(university?.['캠퍼스']||'').trim();
15120:   const regions=[],add=r=>{if(r&&!regions.includes(r))regions.push(r)};
15121:   const parts=campus.split(/[\/·,]/).map(x=>x.trim()).filter(Boolean);
15122:   for(const part of parts)add(uep08251CampusRegion(part,name));
15123:   if(regions.length)return regions;
15124:   if(name==='세종대학교')return ['서울'];
15125:   if(/울산과학기술원|UNIST/i.test(name))return ['경남'];
15126:   const fallback=[['서울',/서울|광운|숭실|서강/],['경기',/경기|ERICA|가천|명지/],['인천',/인천/],['충북',/충북|교원|청주/],['충남',/충남/],['대전',/대전|KAIST|한국과학기술원/],['세종',/^고려대학교 세종|세종캠퍼스/],['강원',/강원|미래캠퍼스/],['부산',/부산|해양/],['대구',/대구|DGIST/],['광주',/광주|GIST/],['전북',/전북/],['전남',/전남|에너지공과/],['경북',/경북|포항|한동|WISE/],['경남',/경남/]];
15127:   for(const [r,re] of fallback)if(re.test(name))add(r);
15128:   if(!regions.length)add('기타');return regions;
15129: }

1: /**

16:  */

60: function installUepDormOutingProcessor() {
61:   const ss = SpreadsheetApp.getActive();
62:   validateRequiredSheets_();
63:   setConfigValue_('SCRIPT_STATUS', 'INSTALLED');
64:   setConfigValue_('SCRIPT_VERSION', UEP_DORM_PROCESSOR.VERSION);
65:   setConfigValue_('PROCESS_PATH', 'FORM→NORMALIZED→DAILY→UEP_DIRECT');
66:   setConfigValue_('LEGACY_TARGET_WRITE', 'DISABLED');
67:   configureSourceFormSafety_();
68:   installUepDormOutingAutoTrigger();
69:   runUepDormOutingProcessor();
70:   ss.toast(
71:     '학사외출 중앙 처리 엔진 설치가 완료되었습니다.',
72:     UEP_DORM_PROCESSOR.MENU,
73:     8
74:   );
75: }

77: function installUepDormOutingAutoTrigger() {
78:   const config = getConfig_();
79:   const interval = Number(config.AUTO_INTERVAL_MINUTES || 5);
80:   const validIntervals = [1, 5, 10, 15, 30];
81:   const minutes = validIntervals.includes(interval) ? interval : 5;
82: 
83:   ScriptApp.getProjectTriggers().forEach((trigger) => {
84:     if (trigger.getHandlerFunction() === UEP_DORM_PROCESSOR.AUTO_HANDLER) {
85:       ScriptApp.deleteTrigger(trigger);
86:     }
87:   });
88: 
89:   ScriptApp.newTrigger(UEP_DORM_PROCESSOR.AUTO_HANDLER)
90:     .timeBased()
91:     .everyMinutes(minutes)
92:     .create();
93: 
94:   setConfigValue_('AUTO_TRIGGER_STATUS', `INSTALLED_${minutes}MIN`);
95:   SpreadsheetApp.getActive().toast(
96:     `${minutes}분 간격 자동 처리 트리거를 설치했습니다.`,
97:     UEP_DORM_PROCESSOR.MENU,
98:     7
99:   );
100: }

102: function runUepDormOutingProcessorAuto() {
103:   const result = processDormOutingPipeline_({ interactive: false });
104:   if (result && result.ok) sendTodayDormOutingMailIfNeeded_();
105: }

107: function runUepDormOutingProcessor() {
108:   return processDormOutingPipeline_({ interactive: true });
109: }

111: function buildDormOutingNormalizedOnly() {
112:   const lock = LockService.getScriptLock();
113:   if (!lock.tryLock(120000)) throw new Error('다른 처리 작업이 진행 중입니다.');
114:   const started = new Date();
115:   try {
116:     const context = loadDormOutingContext_();
117:     const normalized = normalizeDormOutingRows_(context);
118:     const permanentNormalized = mergePermanentRows_(readNormalizedRows_(), normalized.rows, 0);
119:     writeNormalized_(permanentNormalized);
120:     writeErrors_(normalized.errors);
121:     logProcess_('정규화', '성공', started, normalized.rows.length, normalized.errors.length, '');
122:     SpreadsheetApp.getActive().toast(
123:       `정규화 ${normalized.rows.length}건, 오류 ${normalized.errors.length}건`,
124:       UEP_DORM_PROCESSOR.MENU,
125:       8
126:     );
127:   } catch (error) {
128:     logProcess_('정규화', '실패', started, 0, 0, error.message);
129:     throw error;
130:   } finally {
131:     lock.releaseLock();
132:   }
133: }
134: 
135: function buildDormOutingDailyOnly() {
136:   const lock = LockService.getScriptLock();
137:   if (!lock.tryLock(120000)) throw new Error('다른 처리 작업이 진행 중입니다.');
138:   const started = new Date();
139:   try {
140:     const normalizedRows = readNormalizedRows_();
141:     const daily = expandNormalizedRows_(normalizedRows);
142:     const ruledDaily = applyDormRulesToDailyRows_(daily.rows);
143:     writeDaily_(ruledDaily);
144:     writeErrors_(daily.errors);
145:     logProcess_('일자별 전개', '성공', started, daily.rows.length, daily.errors.length, '');
146:     SpreadsheetApp.getActive().toast(
147:       `일자별 ${daily.rows.length}건, 오류 ${daily.errors.length}건`,
148:       UEP_DORM_PROCESSOR.MENU,
149:       8
150:     );
151:   } catch (error) {
152:     logProcess_('일자별 전개', '실패', started, 0, 0, error.message);
153:     throw error;
154:   } finally {
155:     lock.releaseLock();
156:   }
157: }
158: 
159: function processDormOutingPipeline_(options) {
160:   options = options || {};
161:   const lock = LockService.getScriptLock();
162:   if (!lock.tryLock(120000)) {
163:     if (options.interactive) {
164:       SpreadsheetApp.getUi().alert(
165:         '다른 처리 작업이 진행 중입니다.',
166:         '약 1분 뒤 다시 실행해 주세요.',
167:         SpreadsheetApp.getUi().ButtonSet.OK
168:       );
169:     }
170:     return { ok: false, reason: 'LOCKED' };
171:   }
172: 
173:   const started = new Date();
174:   try {
175:     const context = loadDormOutingContext_();
176: 
177:     // 01_학사외출_정규화 = 폼과 독립된 영구 신청 원장.
178:     // 폼에서 과거 응답이 사라지거나 새 폼으로 교체되어도 기존 원장 행을 삭제하지 않습니다.
179:     const normalized = normalizeDormOutingRows_(context);
180:     const permanentNormalized = mergePermanentRows_(
181:       readNormalizedRows_(),
182:       normalized.rows,
183:       0
184:     );
185:     writeNormalized_(permanentNormalized);
186: 
187:     // 02_학사외출_일자별 = 영구 신청 원장을 날짜별로 전개한 UEP 직접조회 원장.
188:     // 규칙로그 40_학사외출규칙의 현재 활성 규칙을 매번 다시 판정합니다.
189:     const daily = expandNormalizedRows_(permanentNormalized);
190:     ensureDormRuleOperationalSchema_();
191:     const ruledDaily = applyDormRulesToDailyRows_(daily.rows);
192:     writeDaily_(ruledDaily);
193: 
194:     const errors = normalized.errors.concat(daily.errors);
195:     writeErrors_(errors);
196: 
197:     setConfigValue_('SCRIPT_VERSION', UEP_DORM_PROCESSOR.VERSION);
198:     setConfigValue_('LAST_SUCCESS_AT', formatDateTime_(new Date()));
199:     setConfigValue_('LAST_NORMALIZED_COUNT', permanentNormalized.length);
200:     setConfigValue_('LAST_SOURCE_NORMALIZED_COUNT', normalized.rows.length);
201:     setConfigValue_('LAST_DAILY_COUNT', ruledDaily.length);
202:     setConfigValue_('LAST_ERROR_COUNT', errors.length);
203:     setConfigValue_('PROCESS_PATH', 'FORM→NORMALIZED→DAILY→UEP_DIRECT');
204:     setConfigValue_('LEGACY_TARGET_WRITE', 'DISABLED');
205: 
206:     logProcess_(
207:       '학사외출 전체 처리',
208:       '성공',
209:       started,
210:       ruledDaily.length,
211:       errors.length,
212:       `원본 ${context.sourceMode} / 신규·갱신 ${normalized.rows.length}건 / 영구원장 ${permanentNormalized.length}건 / 일자별 ${ruledDaily.length}건 / 기본정보 재전송 없음`
213:     );
214: 
215:     if (options.interactive) {
216:       SpreadsheetApp.getUi().alert(
217:         '학사외출 처리 완료',
218:         [
219:           `폼에서 읽은 정규화: ${normalized.rows.length}건`,
220:           `정규화 영구원장: ${permanentNormalized.length}건`,
221:           `일자별·규칙판정: ${ruledDaily.length}건`,
222:           `오류검토: ${errors.length}건`,
223:           '',
224:           '처리경로: 구글폼 → 데이터처리 정규화 → 일자별·규칙판정 → UEP 직접조회',
225:           '기본정보 연결시트에는 학사외출 데이터를 다시 전송하지 않습니다.',
226:         ].join('\n'),
227:         SpreadsheetApp.getUi().ButtonSet.OK
228:       );
229:     }
230: 
231:     return {
232:       ok: true,
233:       normalized: permanentNormalized.length,
234:       sourceNormalized: normalized.rows.length,
235:       daily: ruledDaily.length,
236:       errors: errors.length,
237:     };
238:   } catch (error) {
239:     setConfigValue_('LAST_ERROR_AT', formatDateTime_(new Date()));
240:     setConfigValue_('LAST_ERROR_MESSAGE', error.message);
241:     logProcess_('학사외출 전체 처리', '실패', started, 0, 1, error.stack || error.message);
242:     if (options.interactive) throw error;
243:     return { ok: false, error: error.message };
244:   } finally {
245:     lock.releaseLock();
246:   }
247: }

334: function readFormResponsesAsTable_(form) {
335:   const responses = form.getResponses();
336:   const titles = [];
337: 
338:   responses.forEach((response) => {
339:     response.getItemResponses().forEach((itemResponse) => {
340:       const title = text_(itemResponse.getItem().getTitle());
341:       if (title && !titles.includes(title)) titles.push(title);
342:     });
343:   });
344: 
345:   const headers = ['타임스탬프', '__FORM_RESPONSE_ID__'].concat(titles);
346:   const data = responses.map((response) => {
347:     const answers = {};
348:     response.getItemResponses().forEach((itemResponse) => {
349:       answers[itemResponse.getItem().getTitle()] = itemResponse.getResponse();
350:     });
351:     return [
352:       response.getTimestamp(),
353:       response.getId() || '',
354:     ].concat(titles.map((title) =>
355:       Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(answers, title) ? answers[title] : ''
356:     ));
357:   });
358: 
359:   return { headers, data };
360: }

363: /**
364:  * 실제 구글폼 응답을 UEP 구글폼 응답 수집시트에 완전 동기화합니다.
365:  * FormApp.getResponses() 결과를 기준으로 기존 내용을 모두 지우고 다시 기록하므로,
366:  * 구글폼에서 삭제된 응답도 01_학사외출 탭에서 함께 사라집니다.

368: function syncDormOutingCollectionSheet_(table) {
369:   const cfg = UEP_DORM_PROCESSOR;
370:   const targetSs = SpreadsheetApp.openById(cfg.COLLECTION_SPREADSHEET_ID);
371:   const target = targetSs.getSheetByName(cfg.COLLECTION_SHEET);
372:   if (!target) {
373:     throw new Error(`UEP 응답수집 탭을 찾을 수 없습니다: ${cfg.COLLECTION_SHEET}`);
374:   }
375: 
376:   const headers = Array.isArray(table.headers) ? table.headers : [];
377:   const data = Array.isArray(table.data) ? table.data : [];
378:   if (!headers.length) {
379:     throw new Error('학사외출 구글폼 응답 헤더를 읽지 못했습니다.');
380:   }
381: 
382:   const requiredRows = Math.max(2, data.length + 1);
383:   const requiredCols = headers.length;
384: 
385:   if (target.getMaxRows() < requiredRows) {
386:     target.insertRowsAfter(target.getMaxRows(), requiredRows - target.getMaxRows());
387:   }
388:   if (target.getMaxColumns() < requiredCols) {
389:     target.insertColumnsAfter(target.getMaxColumns(), requiredCols - target.getMaxColumns());
390:   }
391: 
392:   // 남아 있는 삭제 응답까지 제거되도록 기존 데이터 영역을 완전히 비웁니다.
393:   target.getDataRange().clearContent();
394:   target.getRange(1, 1, 1, requiredCols).setValues([headers]);
395: 
396:   if (data.length) {
397:     target.getRange(2, 1, data.length, requiredCols).setValues(data);
398:     target.getRange(2, 1, data.length, 1).setNumberFormat('yyyy-mm-dd hh:mm:ss');
399:   }
400: 
401:   target.setFrozenRows(1);
402:   setConfigValue_('LAST_COLLECTION_SYNC_AT', formatDateTime_(new Date()));
403:   setConfigValue_('LAST_COLLECTION_SYNC_COUNT', data.length);
404: }

865:   const end = rule.end ? toDateOnly_(rule.end) : null;
866:   if (start && d < start) return false;
867:   if (end && d > end) return false;
868:   if (!rule.days || rule.days === '전체') return true;
869:   return rule.days.split(',').map(text_).includes(weekdayKo_(d));

940: function dormMailBody_(rows) {
941:   const now=new Date();
942:   const weekday=Number(Utilities.formatDate(now,UEP_DORM_PROCESSOR.TZ,'u'))%7;
943:   const studentNo=r=>`${text_(r[4])}${text_(r[5])}${String(text_(r[6])).padStart(2,'0')}`;
944:   const name=r=>text_(r[7]),cat=r=>text_(r[9]),op=r=>text_(r[10]),out=r=>text_(r[11])||'-',back=r=>text_(r[12])||text_(r[13])||'-';
945:   const byStudent=(a,b)=>studentNo(a).localeCompare(studentNo(b));
946:   const groupByTime=(list,getter)=>{const map=new Map();list.slice().sort((a,b)=>String(getter(a)).localeCompare(String(getter(b)))||byStudent(a,b)).forEach(r=>{const t=String(getter(r)||'-');if(!map.has(t))map.set(t,[]);map.get(t).push(r);});return [...map.entries()].map(([t,list])=>t+'\n'+list.sort(byStudent).map(r=>studentNo(r)+' '+name(r)).join('\n')).join('\n\n');};
947:   let title='[오늘의 1학년 학사 외출 현황]',lines='';
948:   if(weekday===0){title='[오늘의 1학년 학사 입소 현황]';lines=groupByTime(rows.filter(r=>/입소|재입소|복귀/.test(cat(r))||/입소/.test(op(r))),back);}
949:   else if(weekday===5){title='[오늘의 1학년 학사 퇴소 현황]';lines=groupByTime(rows.filter(r=>op(r)==='귀가형'||/퇴소|귀가/.test(cat(r))),out);}
950:   else {lines=rows.filter(r=>op(r)!=='귀가형'&&!/퇴소|귀가|입소|재입소/.test(cat(r))).slice().sort(byStudent).map(r=>studentNo(r)+' '+name(r)+' / '+out(r)+' → '+back(r)).join('\n');}
951:   return [title,'',lines||'해당 학생 없음','', '이상입니다.'].join('\n');
952: }

954: function sendTodayDormOutingMailIfNeeded_() {
955:   const now=new Date();
956:   const hour=Number(Utilities.formatDate(now,UEP_DORM_PROCESSOR.TZ,'H'));
957:   if(hour<15) return {sent:false,reason:'15시 이전 발송 보류'};
958:   const rows=todayDormRowsForMail_();
959:   if (!rows.length) return {sent:false,reason:'오늘 학사 현황 없음'};
960:   const props=PropertiesService.getScriptProperties();
961:   const dateKey=formatDate_(now);
962:   const signature=Utilities.base64EncodeWebSafe(Utilities.computeDigest(Utilities.DigestAlgorithm.SHA_256, rows.map(r=>[r[0],r[9],r[10],r[11],r[12],r[13],r[27]].join('|')).sort().join('\n'))).slice(0,24);
963:   const key=`DORM_MAIL_${dateKey}`;
964:   if (props.getProperty(key)===signature) return {sent:false,reason:'동일 현황 발송 완료'};
965:   const cfg=getConfig_();
966:   const to=text_(cfg.DORM_DAILY_EMAIL_TO)||Session.getEffectiveUser().getEmail();
967:   if (!to) return {sent:false,reason:'수신 이메일 미설정'};
968:   const prior=Boolean(props.getProperty(key));
969:   const weekday=Number(Utilities.formatDate(now,UEP_DORM_PROCESSOR.TZ,'u'))%7;
970:   const kind=weekday===0?'학사 입소 현황':weekday===5?'학사 퇴소 현황':'학사 외출 현황';
971:   const subject=`${prior?'[변경] ':''}${dateKey.replace(/-/g,'.')}. 오늘의 1학년 ${kind}`;
972:   MailApp.sendEmail({to,subject,body:dormMailBody_(rows),name:'UEP 학사외출'});
973:   props.setProperty(key,signature);
974:   setConfigValue_('LAST_DORM_MAIL_AT',formatDateTime_(now));
975:   setConfigValue_('LAST_DORM_MAIL_COUNT',rows.length);
976:   return {sent:true,count:rows.length,to};
977: }

993: function writeSnapshot_(sheetName, rows, width, formats) {
994:   const sheet = SpreadsheetApp.getActive().getSheetByName(sheetName);
995:   const oldRows = Math.max(0, sheet.getLastRow() - 2);
996:   const clearRows = Math.max(oldRows, rows.length);

1087: function getConfig_() {
1088:   const sheet = SpreadsheetApp.getActive().getSheetByName(UEP_DORM_PROCESSOR.CONFIG_SHEET);
1089:   if (!sheet) throw new Error('00_처리설정 탭이 없습니다.');
1090:

1092:   if (lastRow < 3) return {};
1093: 
1094:   // 표준 구조: A=설정키, B=설정값, C=설명, D=사용여부, E=최종수정일시

1096:   // 실제 기능 토글만 사용여부 FALSE를 존중합니다.
1097:   const values = sheet.getRange(3, 1, lastRow - 2, Math.max(5, sheet.getLastColumn())).getValues();
1098:   const config = {};
1099:   const alwaysReadKeys = new Set([
1100:     'SOURCE_FORM_SPREADSHEET_ID',
1101:     'SOURCE_FORM_SHEET',
1102:     'MASTER_SPREADSHEET_ID',
1103:     'STUDENT_MASTER_SPREADSHEET_ID',

1105:     'STUDENT_MASTER_SHEET',
1106:     'DORM_MASTER_SHEET',
1107:     'TIMEZONE',
1108:     'PROCESS_MODE',
1109:     'STRUCTURE_VERSION',
1110:   ]);
1111: 
1112:   values.forEach((r) => {
1113:     const key = text_(r[0]);
1114:     if (!key) return;
1115: 
1116:     const value = r[1];
1117:     const enabledRaw = r[3];
1118:     const enabledText = String(enabledRaw ?? '').trim().toUpperCase();
1119:     const explicitlyDisabled =
1120:       enabledRaw === false ||
1121:       enabledText === 'FALSE' ||
1122:       enabledText === 'N' ||
1123:       enabledText === 'NO';
1124: 
1125:     if (alwaysReadKeys.has(key) || !explicitlyDisabled) {
1126:       config[key] = value;
1127:     }
1128:   });
1129: 
1130:   return config;
1131: }

1225: function firstValue_(obj, keys) {
1226:   for (const key of keys) {
1227:     if (!Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(obj, key)) continue;
1228:     const value = obj[key];
1229:     if (value !== '' && value !== null && typeof value !== 'undefined') return value;
1230:   }
1231:   return '';
1232: }

167:   const lock = LockService.getScriptLock();
168:   if (!lock.tryLock(120000)) throw new Error('다른 처리 작업이 진행 중입니다.');
169:   const started = new Date();
170:   try {
171:     const count = upsertDailyRowsToTargetDb_();
172:     logProcess_('UEP 최종DB 전송', '성공', started, count, 0, '');
173:     SpreadsheetApp.getActive().toast(
174:       `UEP 최종DB에 ${count}건을 반영했습니다.`,
175:       UEP_DORM_PROCESSOR.MENU,
176:       8
177:     );
178:   } catch (error) {
179:     logProcess_('UEP 최종DB 전송', '실패', started, 0, 0, error.message);
180:     throw error;
181:   } finally {
182:     lock.releaseLock();
183:   }
184: }

186: function processDormOutingPipeline_(options) {
187:   const lock = LockService.getScriptLock();
188:   if (!lock.tryLock(120000)) {
189:     if (options.interactive) {
190:       SpreadsheetApp.getUi().alert(
191:         '다른 처리 작업이 진행 중입니다.',
192:         '약 1분 뒤 다시 실행해 주세요.',
193:         SpreadsheetApp.getUi().ButtonSet.OK
194:       );
195:     }
196:     return;
197:   }
198: 
199:   const started = new Date();
200:   try {
201:     const context = loadDormOutingContext_();
202:     const normalized = normalizeDormOutingRows_(context);
203:     const permanentNormalized = mergePermanentRows_(readNormalizedRows_(), normalized.rows, 0);
204:     writeNormalized_(permanentNormalized);
205: 
206:     const daily = expandNormalizedRows_(permanentNormalized);
207:     const ruledDaily = applyDormRulesToDailyRows_(daily.rows);
208:     writeDaily_(ruledDaily);
209: 
210:     const errors = normalized.errors.concat(daily.errors);
211:     writeErrors_(errors);
212: 
213:     let sent = 0;
214:     const config = context.config;
215:     const writeEnabled = String(config.TARGET_WRITE_ENABLED).toUpperCase() === 'TRUE';
216:     if (options.sendToTarget || writeEnabled) {
217:       sent = upsertDailyRowsToTargetDb_();
218:     }
219: 
220:     setConfigValue_('LAST_SUCCESS_AT', formatDateTime_(new Date()));
221:     setConfigValue_('LAST_NORMALIZED_COUNT', normalized.rows.length);
222:     setConfigValue_('LAST_DAILY_COUNT', daily.rows.length);
223:     setConfigValue_('LAST_ERROR_COUNT', errors.length);
224: 
225:     logProcess_(
226:       '학사외출 전체 처리',
227:       '성공',
228:       started,
229:       daily.rows.length,
230:       errors.length,
231:       `원본 ${context.sourceMode} / 정규화 ${normalized.rows.length}건 / UEP전송 ${sent}건`
232:     );
233: 
234:     if (options.interactive) {
235:       SpreadsheetApp.getUi().alert(
236:         '학사외출 처리 완료',
237:         [
238:           `정규화: ${normalized.rows.length}건`,
239:           `일자별 기록: ${daily.rows.length}건`,
240:           `오류검토: ${errors.length}건`,
241:           `UEP 최종DB 전송: ${sent}건`,
242:           '',
243:           writeEnabled
244:             ? 'TARGET_WRITE_ENABLED=TRUE: 최종DB 전송이 활성화되어 있습니다.'
245:             : '현재 검증 모드이므로 최종DB는 변경하지 않았습니다.',
246:         ].join('\n'),
247:         SpreadsheetApp.getUi().ButtonSet.OK
248:       );
249:     }
250:   } catch (error) {
251:     setConfigValue_('LAST_ERROR_AT', formatDateTime_(new Date()));
252:     setConfigValue_('LAST_ERROR_MESSAGE', error.message);
253:     logProcess_('학사외출 전체 처리', '실패', started, 0, 1, error.stack || error.message);
254:     if (options.interactive) throw error;
255:   } finally {
256:     lock.releaseLock();
257:   }
258: }

304: function readDormOutingSource_(sourceSheet, config) {
305:   const mode = text_(config.SOURCE_READ_MODE || 'FORM_DIRECT').toUpperCase();
306:   if (mode === 'FORM_DIRECT') {
307:     const formUrl = sourceSheet.getFormUrl();
308:     if (formUrl) {
309:       const form = FormApp.openByUrl(formUrl);
310:       const table = readFormResponsesAsTable_(form);
311:       syncDormOutingCollectionSheet_(table);
312:       return {

314:         table,
315:       };
316:     }

319:     if (!allowFallback) {
320:       throw new Error('연결된 구글폼을 찾지 못해 원본 응답을 직접 읽을 수 없습니다.');
321:     }
322:   }
323: 
324:   return {
325:     mode: 'SHEET_FALLBACK',
326:     table: readTableFromRow1_(sourceSheet),

330: function readFormResponsesAsTable_(form) {
331:   const responses = form.getResponses();
332:   const titles = [];
333: 
334:   responses.forEach((response) => {
335:     response.getItemResponses().forEach((itemResponse) => {
336:       const title = text_(itemResponse.getItem().getTitle());
337:       if (title && !titles.includes(title)) titles.push(title);
338:     });
339:   });
340: 
341:   const headers = ['타임스탬프', '__FORM_RESPONSE_ID__'].concat(titles);
342:   const data = responses.map((response) => {
343:     const answers = {};
344:     response.getItemResponses().forEach((itemResponse) => {
345:       answers[itemResponse.getItem().getTitle()] = itemResponse.getResponse();
346:     });
347:     return [
348:       response.getTimestamp(),
349:       response.getId() || '',
350:     ].concat(titles.map((title) =>
351:       Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(answers, title) ? answers[title] : ''
352:     ));
353:   });
354: 
355:   return { headers, data };
356: }

359: /**
360:  * 실제 구글폼 응답을 UEP 구글폼 응답 수집시트에 완전 동기화합니다.
361:  * FormApp.getResponses() 결과를 기준으로 기존 내용을 모두 지우고 다시 기록하므로,
362:  * 구글폼에서 삭제된 응답도 01_학사외출 탭에서 함께 사라집니다.
363:  */
364: function syncDormOutingCollectionSheet_(table) {
365:   const cfg = UEP_DORM_PROCESSOR;
366:   const targetSs = SpreadsheetApp.openById(cfg.COLLECTION_SPREADSHEET_ID);
367:   const target = targetSs.getSheetByName(cfg.COLLECTION_SHEET);
368:   if (!target) {
369:     throw new Error(`UEP 응답수집 탭을 찾을 수 없습니다: ${cfg.COLLECTION_SHEET}`);
370:   }
371: 
372:   const headers = Array.isArray(table.headers) ? table.headers : [];
373:   const data = Array.isArray(table.data) ? table.data : [];
374:   if (!headers.length) {
375:     throw new Error('학사외출 구글폼 응답 헤더를 읽지 못했습니다.');
376:   }
377: 
378:   const requiredRows = Math.max(2, data.length + 1);
379:   const requiredCols = headers.length;
380: 
381:   if (target.getMaxRows() < requiredRows) {
382:     target.insertRowsAfter(target.getMaxRows(), requiredRows - target.getMaxRows());
383:   }
384:   if (target.getMaxColumns() < requiredCols) {
385:     target.insertColumnsAfter(target.getMaxColumns(), requiredCols - target.getMaxColumns());
386:   }
387: 
388:   // 남아 있는 삭제 응답까지 제거되도록 기존 데이터 영역을 완전히 비웁니다.
389:   target.getDataRange().clearContent();
390:   target.getRange(1, 1, 1, requiredCols).setValues([headers]);
391: 
392:   if (data.length) {
393:     target.getRange(2, 1, data.length, requiredCols).setValues(data);
394:     target.getRange(2, 1, data.length, 1).setNumberFormat('yyyy-mm-dd hh:mm:ss');
395:   }
396: 
397:   target.setFrozenRows(1);
398:   setConfigValue_('LAST_COLLECTION_SYNC_AT', formatDateTime_(new Date()));
399:   setConfigValue_('LAST_COLLECTION_SYNC_COUNT', data.length);
400: }

402: function normalizeDormOutingRows_(context) {
403:   const source = context.sourceRows;
739:   const isHome = outingShape === '귀가형';
740: 
741:   if (dateKey > todayKey) return isHome ? '귀가예정' : '외출예정';
742:   if (dateKey < todayKey) return isHome ? '귀가' : '복귀확인필요';
743: 
744:   const now = new Date();
745:   const nowMinutes = now.getHours() * 60 + now.getMinutes();
746:   const outMinutes = timeToMinutes_(outingTime);
747:   const retMinutes = timeToMinutes_(returnTime);
748: 
749:   if (outMinutes >= 0 && nowMinutes < outMinutes) return isHome ? '귀가예정' : '외출예정';
750:   if (isHome) return '귀가';
751:   if (retMinutes >= 0 && nowMinutes > retMinutes) return '복귀확인필요';
752:   return '외출중';
753: }

755: function upsertDailyRowsToTargetDb_() {
756:   const config = getConfig_();
757:   const targetSs = SpreadsheetApp.openById(requiredConfig_(config, 'TARGET_DB_SPREADSHEET_ID'));
758:   const target = targetSs.getSheetByName(requiredConfig_(config, 'TARGET_DB_SHEET'));
759:   if (!target) throw new Error('UEP 최종 학사외출 기록 탭을 찾을 수 없습니다.');
760: 
761:   const dailyRows = readDailyRows_();
762:   const existing = target.getLastRow() >= 4
763:     ? target.getRange(4, 1, target.getLastRow() - 3, 25).getValues()
764:     : [];
765: 
766:   const existingById = new Map(
767:     existing.filter((r) => r[0]).map((r) => [String(r[0]), r])
768:   );
769: 
770:   const now = new Date();
771:   dailyRows.forEach((r) => {
772:     const id = String(r[0]);
773:     const old = existingById.get(id);
774: 
775:     const targetRow = [
776:       id,                // 외출ID
777:       r[3],              // 학생ID
778:       `${r[4]}${r[5]}${String(r[6]).padStart(2, '0')}`, // 학번
779:       r[7],              // 성명
780:       r[5],              // 반
781:       r[6],              // 번호
782:       r[8],              // 신청유형
783:       r[9],              // 외출구분
784:       r[10],             // 운영형태
785:       r[2],              // 외출일자
786:       r[8] === '정기외출' ? '매주반복' : '반복없음',
787:       '',                // 반복요일: 일자별 기록에는 공란
788:       '',                // 적용종료일
789:       r[11],             // 외출시간
790:       r[12],             // 복귀예정시간
791:       r[13],             // 자택도착예정시간
792:       old ? old[16] : '',// 실제복귀시간 보존
821:   markDailyAsSent_();
822:   return dailyRows.length;
823: }

826: /**
827:  * 정규화/일자별 탭은 폼의 스냅샷이 아니라 영구 원장입니다.
828:  * 새 폼으로 교체되거나 원본 응답 탭이 초기화되어도 이미 이관된 행은 삭제하지 않습니다.
829:  * 같은 ID가 다시 들어온 경우에만 최신 정규화 결과로 갱신합니다.
830:  */
831: function mergePermanentRows_(existingRows, incomingRows, keyIndex) {
832:   const map = new Map();
833:   (existingRows || []).filter(r => r && r[keyIndex]).forEach(r => map.set(String(r[keyIndex]), r.slice()));
834:   (incomingRows || []).filter(r => r && r[keyIndex]).forEach(r => map.set(String(r[keyIndex]), r.slice()));
835:   return Array.from(map.values());
836: }

838: function loadActiveDormRules_() {
839:   const ss = SpreadsheetApp.openById(UEP_DORM_PROCESSOR.RULES_SPREADSHEET_ID);
840:   const sh = ss.getSheetByName(UEP_DORM_PROCESSOR.RULES_SHEET);
841:   if (!sh || sh.getLastRow() < 4) return [];
842:   const values = sh.getRange(3, 1, sh.getLastRow() - 2, 18).getValues();
843:   const headers = values[0].map(text_);
844:   return values.slice(1).filter(r => r[0]).map(r => {
845:     const o = {};
846:     headers.forEach((h,i)=>o[h]=r[i]);
847:     return {
848:       id:text_(o['규칙ID']), category:text_(o['규칙유형']), name:text_(o['규칙명']),
849:       start:parseDateTime_(o['시작일시']), end:parseDateTime_(o['종료일시']),
850:       days:normalizeDays_(o['적용요일']||'전체'), effect:text_(o['판정효과']),
851:       lateEntry:text_(o['늦은입소허용']), earlyExit:text_(o['이른퇴소허용']),
852:       reason:text_(o['허용사유']), priority:Number(o['우선순위']||0),
853:       active:text_(o['활성여부']).toUpperCase() !== 'N'
854:     };
855:   }).filter(r=>r.active).sort((a,b)=>b.priority-a.priority);
856: }

858: function dormRuleApplies_(rule, date) {
859:   const d = toDateOnly_(date); if (!d) return false;
860:   const start = rule.start ? toDateOnly_(rule.start) : null;
861:   const end = rule.end ? toDateOnly_(rule.end) : null;
862:   if (start && d < start) return false;
863:   if (end && d > end) return false;
864:   if (!rule.days || rule.days === '전체') return true;
865:   return rule.days.split(',').map(text_).includes(weekdayKo_(d));
866: }

873:     const closure = matched.find(r=>r.category==='closure'||/미운영/.test(r.effect));
874:     const exam = matched.find(r=>r.category==='exam');
894:     out[23]=period?.name||'';

918: function dormMailBody_(rows) {
919:   const now=new Date();
920:   const weekday=Number(Utilities.formatDate(now,UEP_DORM_PROCESSOR.TZ,'u'))%7;
921:   const studentNo=r=>`${text_(r[4])}${text_(r[5])}${String(text_(r[6])).padStart(2,'0')}`;
922:   const name=r=>text_(r[7]),cat=r=>text_(r[9]),op=r=>text_(r[10]),out=r=>text_(r[11])||'-',back=r=>text_(r[12])||text_(r[13])||'-';
923:   const byStudent=(a,b)=>studentNo(a).localeCompare(studentNo(b));
924:   const groupByTime=(list,getter)=>{const map=new Map();list.slice().sort((a,b)=>String(getter(a)).localeCompare(String(getter(b)))||byStudent(a,b)).forEach(r=>{const t=String(getter(r)||'-');if(!map.has(t))map.set(t,[]);map.get(t).push(r);});return [...map.entries()].map(([t,list])=>t+'\n'+list.sort(byStudent).map(r=>studentNo(r)+' '+name(r)).join('\n')).join('\n\n');};
925:   let title='[오늘의 1학년 학사 외출 현황]',lines='';
926:   if(weekday===0){title='[오늘의 1학년 학사 입소 현황]';lines=groupByTime(rows.filter(r=>/입소|재입소|복귀/.test(cat(r))||/입소/.test(op(r))),back);}
927:   else if(weekday===5){title='[오늘의 1학년 학사 퇴소 현황]';lines=groupByTime(rows.filter(r=>op(r)==='귀가형'||/퇴소|귀가/.test(cat(r))),out);}
928:   else {lines=rows.filter(r=>op(r)!=='귀가형'&&!/퇴소|귀가|입소|재입소/.test(cat(r))).slice().sort(byStudent).map(r=>studentNo(r)+' '+name(r)+' / '+out(r)+' → '+back(r)).join('\n');}
929:   return [title,'',lines||'해당 학생 없음','', '이상입니다.'].join('\n');
930: }

932: function sendTodayDormOutingMailIfNeeded_() {
933:   const now=new Date();
934:   const hour=Number(Utilities.formatDate(now,UEP_DORM_PROCESSOR.TZ,'H'));
935:   if(hour<15) return {sent:false,reason:'15시 이전 발송 보류'};
936:   const rows=todayDormRowsForMail_();
937:   if (!rows.length) return {sent:false,reason:'오늘 학사 현황 없음'};
938:   const props=PropertiesService.getScriptProperties();
939:   const dateKey=formatDate_(now);
940:   const signature=Utilities.base64EncodeWebSafe(Utilities.computeDigest(Utilities.DigestAlgorithm.SHA_256, rows.map(r=>[r[0],r[9],r[10],r[11],r[12],r[13],r[27]].join('|')).sort().join('\n'))).slice(0,24);
941:   const key=`DORM_MAIL_${dateKey}`;
942:   if (props.getProperty(key)===signature) return {sent:false,reason:'동일 현황 발송 완료'};
943:   const cfg=getConfig_();
944:   const to=text_(cfg.DORM_DAILY_EMAIL_TO)||Session.getEffectiveUser().getEmail();
945:   if (!to) return {sent:false,reason:'수신 이메일 미설정'};
946:   const prior=Boolean(props.getProperty(key));
947:   const weekday=Number(Utilities.formatDate(now,UEP_DORM_PROCESSOR.TZ,'u'))%7;
948:   const kind=weekday===0?'학사 입소 현황':weekday===5?'학사 퇴소 현황':'학사 외출 현황';

971: function writeSnapshot_(sheetName, rows, width, formats) {
972:   const sheet = SpreadsheetApp.getActive().getSheetByName(sheetName);
973:   const oldRows = Math.max(0, sheet.getLastRow() - 2);
974:   const clearRows = Math.max(oldRows, rows.length);
975:   if (clearRows > 0) sheet.getRange(3, 1, clearRows, width).clearContent();
976: 
977:   if (!rows.length) return;
978:   sheet.getRange(3, 1, rows.length, width).setValues(rows);
979: 
980:   (formats.dateColumns || []).forEach((col) => {
981:     sheet.getRange(3, col, rows.length, 1).setNumberFormat('yyyy-mm-dd hh:mm');
982:   });
983:   (formats.timeColumns || []).forEach((col) => {
984:     sheet.getRange(3, col, rows.length, 1).setNumberFormat('@');
985:   });
986: }

1176: function firstValue_(obj, keys) {
1177:   for (const key of keys) {
1178:     if (!Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(obj, key)) continue;
1179:     const value = obj[key];
1180:     if (value !== '' && value !== null && typeof value !== 'undefined') return value;
1181:   }
1182:   return '';
1183: }

68: function detectHeaderRowIndex(rows) {
69:   const source = Array.isArray(rows) ? rows : [];
70:   const scanLimit = Math.min(source.length, 12);
71:   let bestIndex = -1;
72:   let bestScore = -Infinity;
73: 
74:   for (let index = 0; index < scanLimit; index += 1) {
75:     const cells = (source[index] || []).map(normalizeHeaderText);
76:     const nonEmpty = cells.filter(Boolean);
77:     if (nonEmpty.length < 2) continue;
78: 
79:     const uniqueCount = new Set(nonEmpty).size;
80:     const duplicatePenalty = nonEmpty.length - uniqueCount;
81:     const knownHeaderHits = nonEmpty.filter((value) =>
82:       /^(학생ID|학번|성명|사용성명|학년|반|번호|일자|운영일|일정ID|프로그램ID|강좌ID|기록ID|상태|구분|설정키|파일구분|스프레드시트ID|탭명|탭용도)$/.test(value),
83:     ).length;
273: }

275: function localTime(value) {
276:   if (value === "" || value == null) return "";
277:   if (value instanceof Date && !Number.isNaN(value.getTime()))
278:     return `${String(value.getHours()).padStart(2, "0")}:${String(value.getMinutes()).padStart(2, "0")}`;
279:   if (typeof value === "number") {
280:     const totalMinutes = Math.round((value % 1) * 24 * 60);
281:     return `${String(Math.floor(totalMinutes / 60) % 24).padStart(2, "0")}:${String(totalMinutes % 60).padStart(2, "0")}`;
282:   }
283:   const text = String(value).trim();
284:   if (/^0\.\d+$/.test(text)) return localTime(Number(text));
285:   const match = text.match(/(\d{1,2}):(\d{2})/);
286:   return match ? `${match[1].padStart(2, "0")}:${match[2]}` : text;
287: }

291: function parseGoogleSheetData(sheetMatrices) {
292:   const rowsFrom = (name) => matrixToObjectRows(sheetMatrices[name] || []);
293:   const masters = rowsFrom("02_학생마스터").filter(
294:     (row) => String(row["활성여부"] || "Y").trim() !== "N",
295:   );
296:   const contactSourceRows = rowsFrom("04_학생연락식별정보");
297:   const contacts = new Map(
298:     contactSourceRows
299:       .filter((row) => String(row["현재사용여부"] || "Y").trim() !== "N")
300:       .map((row) => [String(row["학생ID"] || "").trim(), row]),
301:   );
302:   const dormRows = rowsFrom("20_학사생마스터");
303:   const currentDorm = new Map(
304:     dormRows
305:       .filter(
306:         (row) =>
307:           String(row["현재여부"] || "").trim() === "Y" &&
308:           String(row["학사상태"] || "").trim() === "재사",
309:       )
310:       .map((row) => [String(row["학생ID"] || "").trim(), row]),
311:   );
312:   const careerRows = (rowsFrom("05_대학적성데이터").length ? rowsFrom("05_대학적성데이터") : rowsFrom("05_진로희망이력")).filter(row => String(row["현재여부"] || "Y").trim() !== "N");
313:   const careerProfiles = new Map(careerRows.map(row => {
314:     const id=String(row["학생ID"] || "").trim();
315:     const career=String(row["대학적성데이터"] || row["진로희망분야"] || row["진로희망"] || "").trim();
316:     const major=String(row["희망학과"] || row["희망전공"] || "").trim();
317:     const track=String(row["희망계열"] || row["계열"] || "").trim();
318:     const interest=String(row["흥미"] || row["흥미유형"] || row["관심분야"] || "").trim();
319:     const aptitude=String(row["적성"] || row["적성유형"] || row["강점"] || "").trim();

78: function beginCleanShutdown(reason="user-close") {
79:   if (shutdownStarted) return;

207: function parseOwner(text) {
208:   const m=String(text||"").match(/^\(([^)]+)\)/);
209:   const token=(m?.[1]||"").trim();
210:   if(!token) return ["",""];
211:   if(/부$|부\s/.test(token)) return [token.replace(/\s*확정$/,""),""];
212:   const parts=token.split(/\s+/);
213:   if(parts.length>1 && /부$/.test(parts[0])) return [parts[0],parts.slice(1).join(" ")];
214:   return ["",token.replace(/\s*확정$/," ").trim()];
215: }

609: async function getSheetsToken(credentials) {
610:   const now = Math.floor(Date.now() / 1000);
611:   const header = base64url(JSON.stringify({ alg: "RS256", typ: "JWT" }));
612:   const claims = base64url(JSON.stringify({
613:     iss: credentials.client_email,
614:     scope: "https://www.googleapis.com/auth/spreadsheets",
615:     aud: credentials.token_uri,
616:     iat: now,
617:     exp: now + 3600,
618:   }));
619:   const unsigned = `${header}.${claims}`;
620:   const signature = crypto.sign("RSA-SHA256", Buffer.from(unsigned), credentials.private_key).toString("base64url");
621:   const body = new URLSearchParams({
622:     grant_type: "urn:ietf:params:oauth:grant-type:jwt-bearer",
623:     assertion: `${unsigned}.${signature}`,
624:   });
625:   const response = await fetch(credentials.token_uri, {
626:     method: "POST",
627:     headers: { "content-type": "application/x-www-form-urlencoded" },
628:     body,
629:   });
630:   if (!response.ok) throw new Error(`Google 인증 실패 (${response.status})`);
631:   const payload = await response.json();
632:   if (!payload.access_token) throw new Error("Google 인증 토큰을 받지 못했습니다.");
633:   return payload.access_token;
634: }

636: async function readSheetBatch(token, spreadsheetId, ranges, attempt = 0) {
637:   if(String(token||'').startsWith('UEP_SCHOOL_READ:')) return schoolReadBatchRead(spreadsheetId,ranges);
638:   const url = new URL(`https://sheets.googleapis.com/v4/spreadsheets/${spreadsheetId}/values:batchGet`);
639:   url.searchParams.set("majorDimension", "ROWS");
640:   url.searchParams.set("valueRenderOption", "UNFORMATTED_VALUE");
641:   url.searchParams.set("dateTimeRenderOption", "SERIAL_NUMBER");
642:   ranges.forEach((range) => url.searchParams.append("ranges", range));
643:   const response = await fetch(url, { headers: { authorization: `Bearer ${token}` } });
644:   if (!response.ok) {
645:     let detail = "";
646:     try { detail = (await response.json())?.error?.message || ""; } catch {}
647:     if ((response.status === 429 || response.status >= 500) && attempt < 3) {
648:       const retryAfter = Number(response.headers.get("retry-after") || 0);
649:       const waitMs = retryAfter > 0 ? retryAfter * 1000 : 900 * Math.pow(2, attempt);
650:       await new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(resolve, waitMs));
651:       return readSheetBatch(token, spreadsheetId, ranges, attempt + 1);
652:     }
653:     throw new Error(`UEP 구글시트 읽기 실패 (${response.status})${detail ? `: ${detail}` : ""}`);
654:   }
655:   return (await response.json()).valueRanges || [];
656: }

658: function sheetNameFromA1Range(range="") {
659:   const prefix=String(range||"").split("!")[0].trim();
660:   return prefix.replace(/^'/,"").replace(/'$/,"").replace(/''/g,"'");

663: function assignValueRangesByRange(target, entries, valueRanges) {
664:   const logicalBySheet=new Map(entries.map(([logicalName,range])=>[sheetNameFromA1Range(range),logicalName]));
665:   const assigned=new Set();
666:   (Array.isArray(valueRanges)?valueRanges:[]).forEach((item,index)=>{
667:     const responseSheet=sheetNameFromA1Range(item?.range);
668:     // Sheets batchGet may omit empty ranges or return them in a different order.
669:     // A response that names its range must only be assigned to that sheet; index is
670:     // retained solely for legacy responses that contain no range metadata at all.
671:     const logicalName=responseSheet?logicalBySheet.get(responseSheet):entries[index]?.[0];
672:     if(!logicalName)return;
673:     target[logicalName]=item?.values||[];
674:     assigned.add(logicalName);
675:   });
676:   entries.forEach(([logicalName])=>{if(!assigned.has(logicalName)&&!target[logicalName])target[logicalName]=[];});
677:   return target;
678: }

686:     body: JSON.stringify({ majorDimension: "ROWS", values }),
687:   });
688:   if (!response.ok) {
689:     let detail=""; try{ detail=(await response.json())?.error?.message||""; }catch{}
690:     if ((response.status===429 || response.status>=500) && attempt<4) {
691:       const retryAfter=Number(response.headers.get("retry-after")||0);
692:       const waitMs=retryAfter>0?retryAfter*1000:1000*Math.pow(2,attempt);
693:       await new Promise(resolve=>setTimeout(resolve,waitMs));
694:       return updateSheetValues(token,spreadsheetId,range,values,attempt+1);
695:     }
696:     throw new Error(`구글시트 저장 실패 (${response.status})${detail?`: ${detail}`:""}`);
697:   }
698:   return response.json();
699: }

701: async function batchUpdateSheetValues(token, spreadsheetId, data, attempt=0) {
702:   const items=(Array.isArray(data)?data:[]).filter(x=>x&&x.range&&Array.isArray(x.values));
703:   if(!items.length)return {totalUpdatedRows:0};
704:   const url=new URL(`https://sheets.googleapis.com/v4/spreadsheets/${spreadsheetId}/values:batchUpdate`);
705:   const response=await fetch(url,{
706:     method:"POST",
707:     headers:{Authorization:`Bearer ${token}`,"Content-Type":"application/json"},
708:     body:JSON.stringify({valueInputOption:"USER_ENTERED",data:items.map(x=>({range:x.range,majorDimension:"ROWS",values:x.values}))}),
709:   });
710:   if(!response.ok){
711:     let detail="";try{detail=(await response.json())?.error?.message||"";}catch{}
712:     if((response.status===429||response.status>=500)&&attempt<4){
713:       const retryAfter=Number(response.headers.get("retry-after")||0);
714:       const waitMs=retryAfter>0?retryAfter*1000:1000*Math.pow(2,attempt);
715:       await new Promise(resolve=>setTimeout(resolve,waitMs));
716:       return batchUpdateSheetValues(token,spreadsheetId,items,attempt+1);
717:     }
718:     throw new Error(`구글시트 일괄 저장 실패 (${response.status})${detail?`: ${detail}`:""}`);
719:   }
720:   return response.json();
721: }

724: function columnLetter(index) {
725:   let n=Number(index)+1, out="";
726:   while(n>0){ const r=(n-1)%26; out=String.fromCharCode(65+r)+out; n=Math.floor((n-1)/26); }
727:   return out;
728: }
729: function normalizeSheetHeader(value){return String(value??"").replace(/\r?\n/g," ").replace(/\s+/g," ").trim();}
730: function findHeaderRowByRequired(matrix,required){
731:   const wanted=required.map(x=>String(x));
732:   const limit=Math.min(Array.isArray(matrix)?matrix.length:0,12);
733:   for(let i=0;i<limit;i+=1){
734:     const row=(matrix[i]||[]).map(normalizeSheetHeader);
735:     if(wanted.every(name=>row.includes(name))) return {index:i,headers:row};
736:   }
737:   return null;
738: }

1369: async function appendSheetValues(token, spreadsheetId, range, values) {
1370:   const url = new URL(`https://sheets.googleapis.com/v4/spreadsheets/${spreadsheetId}/values/${encodeURIComponent(range)}:append`);
1371:   url.searchParams.set("valueInputOption", "USER_ENTERED");
1372:   url.searchParams.set("insertDataOption", "INSERT_ROWS");
1373:   const response = await fetch(url, {
1374:     method: "POST",
1375:     headers: { Authorization: `Bearer ${token}`, "Content-Type": "application/json" },
1376:     body: JSON.stringify({ majorDimension: "ROWS", values }),
1377:   });
1378:   if (!response.ok) throw new Error(`공지 저장 실패 (${response.status})`);
1379:   return response.json();
1380: }

1382: async function mapWithConcurrency(items, limit, worker) {
1383:   const queue = Array.from(items || []);
1384:   const results = new Array(queue.length);
1385:   let cursor = 0;
1386:   const runners = Array.from({ length: Math.max(1, Math.min(limit, queue.length || 1)) }, async () => {
1387:     while (true) {
1388:       const index = cursor++;
1389:       if (index >= queue.length) return;
1390:       results[index] = await worker(queue[index], index);
1391:     }
1392:   });
1393:   await Promise.all(runners);
1394:   return results;
1395: }

3502: async function readCredentialRecoveryFrom(filePath){
3503:   const payload=JSON.parse(await fs.readFile(filePath,"utf8"));
3504:   if(!payload||payload.version!==1||payload.algorithm!=="aes-256-gcm")throw new Error("invalid recovery credential");
3505:   const salt=Buffer.from(payload.salt,"base64"),iv=Buffer.from(payload.iv,"base64"),tag=Buffer.from(payload.tag,"base64"),data=Buffer.from(payload.data,"base64");
3506:   const decipher=crypto.createDecipheriv("aes-256-gcm",recoveryKey(salt),iv);decipher.setAuthTag(tag);
3507:   return JSON.parse(Buffer.concat([decipher.update(data),decipher.final()]).toString("utf8"));
3508: }

3516:         if(!validateServiceAccount(recovered))continue;
